Every record is also listed by identifier in the

**Curves and residuals** replay the full stored source and reconstructed
coefficients on the same recorded audit inputs. Residual = model − input in
the fitted quantity's native units; for pressure, P(model) − P(input) at each
input volume and temperature (isothermal records use their reference
temperature). RMS is an unweighted descriptive error, not a parameter
uncertainty or the weighted fitting objective. With more than five
temperatures, the minimum, middle and maximum isotherms are drawn; residuals
include every selected row. Error bars appear only where all widths are
recoverable and keep the source meaning, including digitization widths.
No uncertainty band is inferred.

**Coefficient graphs** show stored central values and recorded error widths
in the audit's units; each panel includes zero. They are not observation or
residual plots. Fixed/adopted values are constraints, not recovered values.
Tables round an error to two significant digits when its leading digit is 1
or 2, otherwise one, and the value to the error's decimal place; values
without a positive error show at most six significant digits. Full precision
stays in EOSMAT and the ledger.

## Litasov et al. (2013), natural Fe0.95Mn0.05CO3, 300 K BM3

**reproduced** · `siderite_fe095mn005_litasov_2013_bm3` · `BM3` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/siderite_fe095mn005.md#record-siderite_fe095mn005_litasov_2013_bm3)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** Agreement within the source's reported parameter error widths; this is not an inferred confidence convention.

- Every compared free central value lies inside its printed source error width, with finite reconstructed standard errors under the explicit conditional error model. This is numerical parameter parity, not a formal source-confidence test or recovery of author workflow. Agreement concerns K0 and K0-prime on all 27 printed 300 K rows, conditional on source-fixed V0=293.4 A^3, original printed Au pressures and equal pressure-residual weights. The published-curve pressure RMS remains 0.22958 GPa, outside the manuscript's reported 0.11-0.17 GPa range; that source-data agreement finding is unresolved separately. Exact pressure-scale realization, original objective/weights and author workflow remain unrecovered. No thermal-coefficient conflict or use restriction is resolved by this parameter comparison. Existing reconstructed errors retained; no source confidence convention inferred. Earlier audit statement (superseded only as to missing reconstruction uncertainty and the resulting numerical label): Point estimates fall within the published errors, but source weighting and covariance are unspecified. All 27 printed 300 K rows are retained; the source RMS range is not recovered. The conflicting thermal coefficient is withheld. See literature-reproductions/litasov-2013-siderite.md. See docs/literature-reproductions/uncertainty-reconstruction.md for the complete conditional uncertainty budget.

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** siderite\_fe095mn005\_litasov\_2013\_table2\_pvt
- **Observations:** 27
- **Fit kind:** fixed\_V0\_linearized\_bm3
- **Objective:** unweighted\_pressure\_residuals
- **Weighting:** Existing reconstructed errors retained; no source confidence convention inferred.
- **Absolute sigma:** False
- **Free parameters:** K0; K0\_prime
- **Fixed parameters:** V0

## Peritheos joint thermal refit of Litasov et al. (2013), Fe0.95Mn0.05CO3

**reproduced** · `siderite_fe095mn005_litasov_2013_joint_thermal_refit` · `BM3` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/siderite_fe095mn005.md#record-siderite_fe095mn005_litasov_2013_joint_thermal_refit)

**Scope:** Reproduction of a stored independent Peritheos refit. **Basis:** Reproduction of the stored independent Peritheos refit under its declared protocol.

- This comparison concerns the stored independent Peritheos refit, not recovery of the original publication's coefficients or author workflow.
- Reproduces the separately labelled Peritheos refit, not either published thermal coefficient set. All 111 printed states enter an unweighted joint pressure-residual fit; V0 and Tr are fixed. The ledger's published column contains the stored refit values for this comparison. Formal covariance excludes fixed V0 uncertainty and calibration systematics. Both source thermal variants remain non-executable evidence.

The source/target values below are the stored **Peritheos refit**. Agreement with it does not reproduce the original publication's coefficients.

- **Dataset identifiers:** siderite\_fe095mn005\_litasov\_2013\_table2\_pvt
